topic: Auto-expiry alerts for work permits and visas — how the dashboard surfaces renewals 30/60/90 days out
format: Compare 'how most Oman businesses do X today' with 'how SmartPRO Hub customers do X'
post:
One expired work permit cost an Oman contractor 3x their annual software budget — because nobody noticed until the Ministry did.

SmartPRO Hub customers get an automatic alert 90 days out. Then 60. Then 30.

No chasing. No spreadsheet. No surprise fines because a permit lapsed while everyone assumed someone else was on it.

Here's why that matters more than it sounds.

A single expired work permit can halt a project mid-execution, trigger a Ministry of Labour violation, and end up costing more to resolve than a full year's software subscription. Most businesses only find out when the damage is already done — and by then, the conversation shifts from "how do we fix this" to "who missed it."

The SmartPRO Hub dashboard shows every renewal deadline across your workforce — work permits, visas, residency cards — colour-coded by urgency, with one-click action. Your PRO team sees what's coming. HR sees it too. There's no version of events where it slips through because one person was on leave or a spreadsheet wasn't updated.

We built this because tracking expiry dates shouldn't live in anyone's head, or in a shared Excel file that may or may not reflect reality today.

So — how many expiry dates are you tracking manually right now? And how confident are you that none are weeks away from lapsing?
